name: SpecDown
subtitle: Markdown & Mermaid viewer
promotional_text: A fast, native-feeling Markdown viewer with live Mermaid diagrams, split source view, tabs and Dark Mode. Free, private, no account.
description:
SpecDown is a fast, clean viewer for Markdown files — built for specs, design docs, READMEs and notes that include diagrams.

Double-click a .md file or drag it onto SpecDown and it renders instantly: headings, tables, links, images and syntax-highlighted code, plus Mermaid diagrams drawn right in the document.

MERMAID DIAGRAMS, RENDERED LIVE
• Flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, Gantt charts and more
• Open any diagram fullscreen to zoom and pan
• Diagrams follow your light or dark appearance

BUILT FOR TECHNICAL WRITING
• Split view: Markdown source beside the rendered preview
• Table of contents for long documents
• Tabs for working across several files
• Presentation mode to step through a document
• Print or export to PDF

[VERIFY IN SANDBOX BEFORE KEEPING] Live reload when the file changes on disk • Workspace folders • Custom CSS themes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
SpecDown has no accounts, ads, analytics or tracking. Your documents stay on your Mac; the app only goes online when you open a link or a document that references web images.
